rationale: Clause K5-1 (sha256 9aed45811b2c5e4b043d430dd6cd5fb6afd32e254db00ae1d531139ae4f3a979): "Scope, order and prerequisites: one separately authorized stage in the fresh T5, steps P1 P0 Q5 K5a K5b K5M K5g H5 Z51 Z52 once each in order, only after the K4H actual-result review closed with KH3 10/10, KH6 PASS and no relation-level security finding, after the root records two substantive agreeing positions on the K5 clauses and an exact crypto authorization naming DV-K2-1-R. Nothing in K5 proves, verifies, pairs, publishes a key or touches any ledger, wallet or network." Operative source evidence: verified in `operator/request/data/k5_preconditions.py` (`FIXED["T5"]` line 34 naming `/home/charl/moriarty-eutxo-validation-2026-10-12/current-cardano-k2-k5-single-party-test-setup-20261016`, `STEPS` line 38, `CLAUSES` line 39, `DV_PREFIX = "b04371a2"` line 40, `REVIEW_VALUES` lines 60-62, `AUTH_VALUES` lines 63-76, `t5_state()` lines 200-206, `preconditions()` lines 261-296, `k4h_outputs()` lines 298-319, `authorization()` lines 320-335, `pre_launch()` lines 336-341), `operator/request/OPERATOR-STEPS.md` (lines 5-57), and `operator/request/steps/P1.sh` through `Z52.sh` (`once()` and `need()` guards enforcing single ordered execution of `P1 P0 Q5 K5a K5b K5M K5g H5 Z51 Z52`, with only `mori-k2 compile` in `K5a.sh` line 76 / `K5b.sh` line 73 and one `mori-k2 setup` of `invoice/partial` in `K5M.sh` line 81, and zero prove, verify, pairing, key-publication, wallet, ledger, or network actions).

Clause K5-2 (sha256 56344c2c1399406abc05e88c105b8ade712951d82c47d92826a0c12dd407ba75): "The run view sbx_run exactly as implemented in Q5, K5a, K5b and K5M: no toolchain, cargo home, registry, target, home or host path; read-only bin and in; writable out and keys only; synthetic /dev, tmpfs /tmp, loopback-only networking, stdin /dev/null; probed in full by Q5 before any mori-k2 compile runs." Operative source evidence: verified in `sbx_run()` in `operator/request/steps/Q5.sh` (lines 26-35), `K5a.sh` (lines 26-35), `K5b.sh` (lines 26-35), and `K5M.sh` (lines 26-35), which identically invoke `/usr/bin/bwrap --unshare-user --unshare-pid --unshare-net --unshare-ipc --unshare-uts --die-with-parent --new-session --ro-bind /usr /usr --ro-bind /bin /bin --ro-bind /lib /lib --ro-bind /lib64 /lib64 --ro-bind-try /etc/ld.so.cache /etc/ld.so.cache --dev /dev --proc /proc --size 268435456 --tmpfs /tmp --ro-bind "$W/bin" /task/bin --ro-bind "$W/in" /task/in --bind "$W/out" /task/out --bind "$W/keys" /task/keys --chdir /task --clearenv --setenv PATH /usr/bin:/bin --setenv HOME /nonexistent -- "$@" < /dev/null`, and in `Q5.sh` (lines 64, 74-81) + `operator/request/data/probe-k5.sh` (lines 10-94), which probe `CapEff == 0000000000000000`, namespace inequality against host `user/pid/net/ipc/uts` links, loopback-only `lo`, `visible_pids <= 16`, absence of `$HOSTROOT` and toolchain/cargo/target/home paths, read-only mounts on `/usr /bin /lib /lib64 /task/bin /task/in`, read-write empty `/task/out` and `/task/keys` (mode `700`), `tmpfs` `/tmp`, synthetic `/dev/{null,urandom,random}`, stdin `/dev/null`, cleared environment, and `/usr/bin/time -v` before `K5a.sh` (`need P1 P0 Q5`, line 64) runs.

Clause K5-4M (sha256 52b985bea9495f206817806dd5077dd83dbc6cd76fb7d0a41358552adf0c78ab): "Bounded first setup measurement: K5a and K5b at CPU/wall 600/900, Q5 at 120/300, host steps at 300/600 or less, and K5M as one process with RLIMIT_AS 8 GiB, RLIMIT_CORE 0, nice 10, RLIMIT_CPU 3600 s, wall 3600 s plus kill-after 60 s, GNU time inside the view, and the 10 GiB MemAvailable and 6 GiB disk gates immediately before. One attempt, zero retries, no cap change." Operative source evidence: verified in `run_step()` (`nice -n 10 timeout --kill-after=60 "$3" prlimit --as=8589934592 --cpu="$5" --core=0`, lines 20-22 of `P0.sh`, `Q5.sh`, `K5a.sh`, `K5b.sh`, `K5M.sh`, `K5g.sh`, `H5.sh`, `Z51.sh`), step invocations (`P0.sh` lines 60/83 wall 600/CPU 300; `Q5.sh` lines 74/81 wall 300/CPU 120; `K5a.sh` lines 73/81 wall 900/CPU 600; `K5b.sh` lines 70/78 wall 900/CPU 600; `K5M.sh` lines 77/83 wall 3600/CPU 3600 with `/usr/bin/time -v` inside `sbx_run` at line 81; `K5g.sh` lines 62/65 wall 600/CPU 300; `H5.sh` lines 34/40 wall 120/CPU 60; `Z51.sh` lines 59/75 wall 600/CPU 300), `res_ok()` (`K5M.sh` lines 54-57, called at line 77 immediately before `sbx_run`, gating free disk `>= 6442450944` bytes and `MemAvailable >= 10485760` kB), and `once()` single-attempt guards (`K5M.sh` lines 61, 63) plus `k5_preconditions.py` (`AUTH_VALUES` lines 67-70: `attempts: 1`, `retries: 0`, `setupInvocations: 1`).

Clause K5-5 (sha256 d413d2e2c3fcaa371256a74718b8d7cb9e18aa3ba7ca5b0011c9f0bc97cb819d): "Classification as implemented by the step texts and gate verdict mapping: P1/P0 precondition refusals are BLOCKED(prerequisite); Q5 failure BLOCKED(capability); pin, binary, descriptor and root-record mismatches BLOCKED(identity); K5g STOP-CUSTODY BLOCKED(hygiene), STOP-IDENTITY BLOCKED(identity), FAIL-PREDICTION FAILED(prediction), and a gate run without a verdict BLOCKED(environment); K5M timeout, SIGKILL, SIGXCPU or allocation failure BLOCKED(resource); a getrandom failure is BLOCKED(abnormal-exit) and takes precedence over any generic failure label; any other signal death or panic is BLOCKED(abnormal-exit); a mori-k2 refused: or usage: outcome is FAILED(prediction) except an I/O refusal naming a path P0 verified, which is BLOCKED(layout); H5 classifies nothing; Z51 and Z52 failures are BLOCKED(hygiene), after which no K5 result qualifies. No BLOCKED class is ever FAILED. Scripts record; the fresh actual-result reviewer classifies from the full logs." Operative source evidence: verified in `operator/request/data/k5_preconditions.py` (lines 17-19, 353-355 emitting `BLOCKED(prerequisite)`), `Q5.sh` (lines 67-81) and `probe-k5.sh` (lines 11-94), `pins_ok()` and `bin_ok()` across `P0.sh`..`Z51.sh` plus `cmp` descriptor checks in `K5a.sh` (lines 70, 78) and `K5b.sh` (lines 69, 75) (`BLOCKED(identity)`), `res_ok()` (`BLOCKED(resource)`), `operator/request/data/k5g_gate.py` (lines 14-25, 177-181, 385-398, 443-448 enforcing `STOP-CUSTODY` -> `BLOCKED(hygiene)`, `STOP-IDENTITY` -> `BLOCKED(identity)`, `FAIL-PREDICTION` -> `FAILED(prediction)`, and `REFUSED` exit 2 -> `BLOCKED(environment)`), `K5M.sh` (lines 74-76), `H5.sh` (lines 4, 29-40 extracting time and abnormal/getrandom/signal/refused lines while classifying nothing), and `Z51.sh` (lines 57-72) / `Z52.sh` (`OPERATOR-STEPS.md` lines 44-45, `BLOCKED(hygiene)`).

Clause K5-7 (sha256 b6ba0ca3a5efad3c8feb6a12a9aa6d03f5a27546e80190c9b72fff9667d8b161): "Custody, retention and publication: all operator source is pinned by the root before use and re-verified in final hygiene; T5/w is retained unchanged until the K5 actual-result review closes; the proving key is recorded only by path, mode, size, link count and SHA-256 behind lstat and O_NOFOLLOW guards, and only when the custody guard permits; leftovers of a failed invocation stay in place, are recorded the same way and are never reused; no step deletes anything; publishable material is logs, journals and receipts only, never w, binaries, keys, caches or host files; key deletion is a later separately reviewed exact custody step at review close unless that review names a retaining follow-up." Operative source evidence: verified in `P1.sh` (line 29), `pins_ok()` in `P0.sh`..`K5g.sh`, and `Z51.sh` (line 59) re-verifying `RR5/K5-OPERATOR-PINS.sha256`; `k5g_gate.py` (`open_listed()` lines 111-120, `listing()` lines 142-150, `keys_listing()` lines 219-240, `proving_key()` lines 308-340 using `os.lstat` and `O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC`, requiring `S_ISREG`, mode `0600`, `st_nlink == 1`, `st_uid == os.getuid()`, and recording only `path`, `bytes`, `mode`, `nlink`, `sha256`); `Z51.sh` (lines 47, 51-75 recording leftovers or completed keys only when `! -L`, `-f`, mode `600`, `nlink == 1` hold, with zero deletion commands in any step); and `Z52.sh` (line 26) + `claim-utxo-abi-v1-aiken-placement-candidate-20261015/tools/freeze.py` (lines 14-35), which freeze only `T5/logs` and `T5/receipts` into `T5/receipts/stage-K5-final.json` and never read or publish `T5/w`.
